name: Aurin
summary: A dark product site for noise-cancelling earbuds, with a drawn case that opens as you scroll
about: A cinematic product site for wireless earbuds in deep midnight and electric cyan. Full-screen sections snap as you scroll, and a charging case drawn in SVG opens its lid while the buds rise out with labelled parts. A noise slider calms a live city waveform, a phone and laptop share one pair, a battery timeline plays out a whole day, and the shop, compare, specs, support, account and checkout pages all work.
how: Scroll the home page: sections snap, the dots on the right follow you and the case lid opens as you leave the first screen
In Quiet, pick Bus, Street, Cabin or Platform and drag the slider or choose Off, Aware, Adaptive or Max to calm the waveform
In Two devices, press Ring the phone (or wait), answer on the phone card and watch the music hand back after the call
Switch the battery day between Drift, Core and Halo, turn noise cancelling off or add a top-up, and move along the line
Pick a colour to recolour every render, then build a pair on the buy page with a tip size, free engraving and Aurin Care
Open the bag, check out with the demo card 4242 4242 4242 4242, then track the order in your account
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset the demo data from the account page or the footer
